schema: CREATE TABLE users (id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, name TEXT); CREATE TABLE posts (id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, user_id INTEGER, title TEXT, FOREIGN KEY (user_id) REFERENCES users(id));
correct_query: SELECT u.name, p.title FROM users u LEFT JOIN posts p ON u.id = p.user_id;

expected_semantic_errors_to_be_caught.description: Model uses an INNER JOIN instead of a LEFT JOIN, improperly excluding users who have not made any posts.
expected_semantic_errors_to_be_caught.query: SELECT u.name, p.title FROM users u INNER JOIN posts p ON u.id = p.user_id;
SELECT u.name, p.title FROM users u JOIN posts p ON u.id = p.user_id;

expected_semantic_errors_to_be_caught.description: Replaced LEFT JOIN with RIGHT JOIN
expected_semantic_errors_to_be_caught.query: SELECT u.name, p.title FROM users u RIGHT JOIN posts p ON u.id = p.user_id;

expected_semantic_errors_to_be_caught.description: Replaced LEFT JOIN with FULL OUTER JOIN
expected_semantic_errors_to_be_caught.query: SELECT u.name, p.title FROM users u FULL OUTER JOIN posts p ON u.id = p.user_id;

expected_semantic_errors_to_be_caught.description: Replaced LEFT JOIN with CROSS JOIN
expected_semantic_errors_to_be_caught.query: SELECT u.name, p.title FROM users u CROSS JOIN posts p ON u.id = p.user_id;
